text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"Bachelor's degree from MIT vs Master's from Ohio State","dimension":"academic pedigree","description":"This captures the level and perceived strength of formal education presented as evidence of fit.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"3 years at Milldam vs 5 years at Wayfair","dimension":"professional experience depth","description":"This captures how much total relevant software-development experience the applicant claims.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Go is my principal programming language\" vs \"writing Go alongside 2 other languages\"","dimension":"Go centrality","description":"This captures how prominently Go is positioned as the applicant's main language versus one among several.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I have designed and delivered automation for vulnerability report triage\" vs \"automated the intake and triage of vulnerability reports\"","dimension":"security automation ownership","description":"This captures direct experience building workflows that handle vulnerability reports and reduce manual security work.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I have architected agentic tooling ... Go back-end infrastructure and Python agents\" vs \"integrating language models into production workflows\"","dimension":"AI agent experience","description":"This captures hands-on experience with AI-related systems, especially agentic or model-driven tooling.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"security reviews of services I did not write\" vs no comparable claim","dimension":"security assessment experience","description":"This captures evidence of performing security reviews or attacker-minded analysis of systems.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I am the maintainer of an open-source tooling project\" vs no open-source mention","dimension":"open-source leadership","description":"This captures community-facing technical ownership outside the applicant's employer, such as maintaining and releasing shared tooling.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"OSCP plus recurring CTF participation vs OSCP only","dimension":"offensive security practice","description":"This captures practice-oriented security credentials and ongoing offensive-security exercise beyond certification alone.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"foundational systems at Google's scale / entire development lifecycle vs foundation layer / every user downstream","dimension":"systems perspective","description":"This captures whether the letter frames the work in terms of broad platform impact and organizational scale.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"best outcome is that nothing happens\" opening vs more direct professional opening","dimension":"rhetorical framing","description":"This captures the style of the opening pitch, whether it uses a memorable conceptual hook or a straightforward qualifications-based introduction.","winner":"B"}]}
